description: JK-01 serves the Regional Transport Office (RTO) in Srinagar, the summer capital of Jammu and Kashmir. It is responsible for motor vehicle registration, driver licensing, and enforcement of transport regulations across the Srinagar district.
address: RTO Srinagar, Chattabal, Srinagar, Jammu and Kashmir

description: The JK-02 RTO serves the Jammu district, acting as a critical hub for transport administration in the winter capital of the Union Territory. It handles a high volume of vehicle registrations, fitness certificates, and licensing services for both private and commercial transport sectors.
address: Transport Nagar, Narwal Bala, Jammu, Jammu and Kashmir

description: The JK-03 RTO serves the Anantnag district in the Kashmir valley, operating as an Assistant Regional Transport Office (ARTO). address: Assistant Regional Transport Office (ARTO) Anantnag, Court Road, Mehman Mohalla, Anantnag, Jammu & Kashmir

description: The JK-04 Assistant Regional Transport Office (ARTO) serves the Budgam district within the Kashmir division. It is the primary authority for vehicle registration, driving licenses, and transport permit issuance for the residents of Budgam and surrounding tehsils.
address: Assistant Regional Transport Office (ARTO), Budgam, Srinagar-Budgam Road, Budgam, Jammu and Kashmir

description: The JK-05 RTO office serves the Baramulla district in the Kashmir division of Jammu and Kashmir. As an Assistant Regional Transport Office (ARTO), it manages vehicle registration, permits, and driving licenses for one of the most populous districts in the valley.
